title: Neiyi prescription of QIU activates ferroptosis to alleviate endometriosis via tumor protein 53.
authors: Li, Hui; Zhou, Xiaoqing; Mei, Shanshan; Mao, Peiyu; Shi, Xinhe; Yang, Huadi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过p53激活铁死亡治疗子宫内膜异位症，仅涉及分子对接预测小分子与p53蛋白的相互作用，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合位点预测或互作机制建模，且方法以湿实验为主，与本课题无关。
abstract: Neiyi prescription of QIU (NYPQ) treated endometriosis (Ems). This study aims to explore the molecular mechanism of NYPQ in Ems treatment. Ems model rats were treated with NYPQ (6.3, 12.5 and 25 g/kg), p53 activator (Parthenolide/PTL) and inhibitor (pifithrin-micro/PFTmicro), ferroptosis inhibitor (ferrostatin-1/Fer-1) and inducer (erastin). Hematoxylin-eosin staining, immunohistochemistry, Western blot, and transmission electron microscopes were used for pathology and ferroptosis evaluation. Malondialdehyde (MDA), the System Xc-glutathione, ferrous ion (Fe(2+)) and reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels were measured using commercial kits. NYPQ activated p53 and ferroptosis signaling pathways in a dose-dependent manner. NYPQ and PTL both decreased lesion volume, glutathione level and expressions of solute carrier family 7 member 11 and glutathione peroxidase 4 while improving tissue pathological damage, activating expressions of p53, prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase 2, and NADPH oxidase 1, and increasing MDA, Fe(2+) and ROS levels. Additionally, Fer-1 partially reversed the excitatory effects of PTL on ferroptosis. Fer-1 and PFTmicro both exacerbated Ems symptoms meanwhile weakened ferroptosis. Notably, they antagonized improving effect of NYPQ on Ems and activation of ferroptosis. Moreover, the combination of erastin with PFTmicro reversed the inhibition of PFTmicro on NYPQ treating Ems, meanwhile activating ferroptosis. Molecular docking predicted that icariin may interact with p53 and acts as a candidate active component of NYPQ. This study highlights the beneficial effects of p53 signaling pathway activation and NYPQ induced ferroptosis on Ems therapy.
abstract_zh: 邱氏内异方（NYPQ）治疗子宫内膜异位症（Ems）。本研究旨在探讨NYPQ治疗Ems的分子机制。将Ems模型大鼠分别用NYPQ（6.3、12.5和25 g/kg）、p53激活剂（Parthenolide/PTL）和抑制剂（pifithrin-micro/PFTmicro）、铁死亡抑制剂（ferrostatin-1/Fer-1）和诱导剂（erastin）处理。采用苏木精-伊红染色、免疫组织化学、Western blot和透射电子显微镜评估病理和铁死亡情况。使用商业试剂盒测定丙二醛（MDA）、System Xc-谷胱甘肽、亚铁离子（Fe(2+)）和活性氧（ROS）水平。NYPQ以剂量依赖性方式激活p53和铁死亡信号通路。NYPQ和PTL均减少病灶体积、谷胱甘肽水平及溶质载体家族7成员11和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4的表达，同时改善组织病理损伤，激活p53、前列腺素内过氧化物合酶2和NADPH氧化酶1的表达，并增加MDA、Fe(2+)和ROS水平。此外，Fer-1部分逆转了PTL对铁死亡的兴奋效应。Fer-1和PFTmicro均加重Ems症状，同时削弱铁死亡。值得注意的是，它们拮抗了NYPQ对Ems的改善作用及铁死亡的激活。此外，erastin与PFTmicro联合使用逆转了PFTmicro对NYPQ治疗Ems的抑制作用，同时激活铁死亡。分子对接预测淫羊藿苷可能与p53相互作用，并作为NYPQ的候选活性成分。本研究强调了p53信号通路激活和NYPQ诱导的铁死亡对Ems治疗的 beneficial 效应。
